feat: Implement widget hot reload functionality for development

- Added WIDGET-HOT-RELOAD-GUIDE.md to document the hot reload process.
- Created WidgetReloader component for UI feedback and reload functionality.
- Developed API endpoint to serve widget HTML files from the local filesystem.
- Introduced widgetHotReload utility for programmatic widget reloading.
- Enhanced WidgetEmbed component to support dynamic loading in development mode.
- Implemented security checks to prevent directory traversal in API.
- Updated documentation with usage examples and troubleshooting tips.
\n\nAuthor: mccal
